evidence_summary: Independently verified 9 primary evidence files: (1) 19yr center-projected combined_results.json (122k decisions, exact k-NN) — LangDom=0.8603 FAIL, JP=0.3685 FAIL; (2) 20yr dense evaluation — LangDom=0.98275 FAIL, JP=0.0475 FAIL (catastrophic degradation); (3) 19yr linear_combinations_eval — linear_citation_concat JP=0.5445 PASS, linear_hybrid05_concat JP=0.5395 PASS, both below TF-IDF baseline 0.7235; (4) 15yr linear_hybrid05 — JP=0.473 FAIL confirming scale dependency; (5) Section cross-lingual 1K sample — sachverhalt cp_64 invariance_gap=0.187 vs erwaegungen 0.452; (6) v8 holdout_zero_shot_validation_fixed — all 4 zero-shot hybrids PASS on true holdout, leakage delta quantified; (7) TF-IDF 174k formal suite — 8 representations, best cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 LangDom=0.47725 JP=0.7345; (8) Checkpoints progress — 129,680/173,963 decisions (74.5%), years 2000-2019 only; (9) v29 final report — all claims consistent with raw evidence. All negative results (boilerplate resistance, v18 hierarchy, v17b regime shift, citation heritage text-based FAIL) honestly reported as first-class evidence. No leakage, gaming, or prettiness-as-quality detected.
